title: Weighted Dijoin Packing in One-Edge Deletions of Chordal Digraphs
decided_scope: For every finite loopless digraph whose underlying simple graph becomes chordal upon adding at most one edge and every nonnegative integer capacity function w, the maximum w-packing of dijoins equals the minimum w-dicut weight
open_boundaries: Unrestricted Woodall's conjecture for general digraphs
